# `company.payroll_operations`

PRIVATE permanent payroll retry receipts; absent from general operation-key output.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `operation_key` | VARCHAR(128) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | PRIVATE permanent retry key, scoped to company. |
| `actor_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Principal owning this retry. |
| `command` | VARCHAR(60) | no | — | — | — | — | Payroll command that wrote the result. |
| `input_hash` | VARCHAR(64) | no | — | — | — | — | SHA-256 of canonical input. |
| `output` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | PRIVATE exact response, including pay amounts; requires current payroll authority. |
| `reason` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | PRIVATE reason for the operation. |
